prompts.thorn: Create a single isolated modular thorn-carapace component for GenVo's near-vertical TOP-DOWN native32 pixel-art creature system. True transparent background. No creature body, legs, eyes, head, tail, text, UI, floor, glow or cast shadow. Directly overhead view, horizontal long axis points right. A broad low asymmetric oval organic carapace with three interlocking sage-green leathery scute lobes and FOUR short stout ivory keratin thorns projecting outward diagonally from the outer shoulders, seen foreshortened from above, each with a dark rooted socket and tapered warm ivory tip. Broad scute surface must remain visible between thorns. Not a side-elevation row of upright fence pins, not a crown, not a metal shield, not a whole animal. Mounting area at centre remains continuous opaque skin. Calm low relief overhead light, deep green-black seams, sage/jade middle value, pale muted lichen highlight, restrained pixel clusters. Strong distinct small silhouette designed to survive mechanical sampling into about 22x20 pixels inside native32. Limit detail to 5 broad skin value groups plus warm ivory keratin. Sharp pixel-art edges, no antialias haze. Entire component centred, detached, generous transparent margin. Separate warm ivory material visibly different from cool skin so a protected pigment mask can be mechanically sampled. Functional organic anatomy, cohesive with an overhead biological survival game.
prompts.spine: Create one isolated modular dorsal SPINE RIDGE component for GenVo's near-vertical overhead native32 pixel-art creature game. Actual transparent background. Not a creature, not a crown or weapon: no head, body, legs, face, tail, scene, text, shadow or glow. A narrow horizontal low sage-green leathery dorsal ridge pointing right, direct TOP-DOWN view. Along its centre a tight connected line of four stout warm ivory keratin quills swept backward towards the left, with alternating short lateral outward thorn tips, seen foreshortened from above. The quills overlap at their dark rooted sockets like natural porcupine/scute anatomy, not three upright straight fence posts in side view. Continuous central green skin saddle at the attachment root. Strong elongated asymmetrical silhouette, narrow compared to a broad shell, broad dark seams separate ivory points from jade skin. Cohesive small pixel clusters with 5 cool skin values plus warm ivory material; no excessive tiny texture. Native preparation target about 24x12 pixels inside a 32x32 transparent frame; make each quill silhouette broad enough to retain at this size. Entire component centred with generous transparent margin. Ivory/pale tan keratin must be clearly separated in hue from muted cool sage skin for mechanical protected-material mapping. No metallic surfaces or ornamental jewel. Organic top-down defensive anatomy.
